projects.name: Chelsea Creek Water Quality Monitoring
projects.description: ECO youth work with academic partners on a data visualization project tracking violations at the seven oil terminals along Chelsea Creek.

projects.name: Chelsea Heat Island Studies
projects.description: ECO youth monitor and map urban heat island impacts across Chelsea.

projects.name: ECO Community Murals
projects.description: Youth design and paint murals around Chelsea, including storm drain designs that warn against pollution.

fields.description: Mass Audubon's 1,183-acre wildlife sanctuary in South Wellfleet on Cape Cod, which runs nature programs and long-running research and rescue work on sea turtles, diamondback terrapins, horseshoe crabs and migrating birds on the Outer Cape.

events.name: Twilight Trek: Moonrise over Wellfleet Bay
events.location: Wellfleet Bay Wildlife Sanctuary, South Wellfleet
events.description: Guided evening walk at sunset and full-moon rise, listening for owls and other nocturnal wildlife.

events.name: 2026 State of Wellfleet Harbor Conference
events.location: Nauset Regional High School, 100 Cable Rd, Eastham, MA
events.description: Free annual conference where scientists and community members share the latest research and monitoring on Wellfleet Harbor and its ecosystem.

projects.name: Cold-Stunned Sea Turtle Rescue
projects.description: Since 1979 sanctuary staff and over 200 trained volunteers patrol Cape Cod beaches each fall to find and rescue cold-stunned sea turtles.

projects.name: Diamondback Terrapin Monitoring
projects.description: Monitoring of Outer Cape populations of the state-threatened diamondback terrapin, ongoing since 1980.

projects.name: Horseshoe Crab Research
projects.description: Research and monitoring of Atlantic horseshoe crab populations on the Outer Cape since 1990 to support a sustainable fishery and local conservation.

actions.name: Donate to the sea turtle rescue effort
actions.description: Give money or supplies to support the yearly rescue of cold-stunned sea turtles on Cape Cod.

fields.description: Statewide environmental advocacy group, part of Environment America and The Public Interest Network, that campaigns on clean energy and solar, protecting bees and oceans, forests and reducing plastic.

projects.name: Save the Bees
projects.description: Campaign to protect bees, including pushing Massachusetts to restrict neonicotinoid-coated seeds.

projects.name: Protect Our Oceans
projects.description: Campaign to protect ocean life off Massachusetts, including North Atlantic right whales.

actions.name: Ask Governor Healey to ban neonic-coated seeds
actions.description: Sign a petition asking the governor to restrict bee-killing neonicotinoid-coated seeds in Massachusetts.

actions.name: Tell your senators: protect right whales
actions.description: Send a message to your U.S. senators asking them to protect North Atlantic right whales.

fields.description: Boston-based organizing group that works with communities facing pollution threats across New England, helping residents build power against polluters on energy, water (including PFAS), waste and toxics.

projects.name: Fix the Grid
projects.description: Grassroots campaign across the six Northeast states pushing regional energy regulators toward wind, solar and storage instead of fossil fuels.

projects.name: National PFAS Contamination Coalition
projects.description: Coalition of about 30 PFAS-impacted community groups nationwide working for clean water and polluter accountability.

fields.description: Group of Greater Boston physicians and health experts who speak out on the health harms of climate change and fossil fuels, for example urging banks to stop financing Arctic drilling.
Fee-only financial advisory firm in Roslindale, Boston, that offers ESG investing with fossil-fuel exclusions and local impact investing in climate justice and community economies.

projects.name: Resiliency and Affordability Program
projects.description: A $7.5 million, 15-year fund from Vineyard Power's community benefits agreement with Vineyard Wind that pays for solar and battery storage at island critical facilities and subsidizes electricity bills for income-eligible households.

projects.name: Mass Save Community First Partnership
projects.description: Partnership with the six island towns and Cape Light Compact to raise participation in Mass Save energy efficiency and electrification programs on Martha's Vineyard.

actions.name: Join the CCL North Shore chapter
actions.description: Sign up to volunteer with the chapter covering Salem, Lynn, Beverly, Newburyport, Gloucester, Peabody, Danvers and Essex County, building support for climate laws and meeting members of Congress.

projects.name: Accelerating Climate Resilience Grant Program
projects.description: Grant program with the Barr Foundation funding 12-month municipal and community projects of up to $50,000 that protect people and places from climate impacts, with a focus on climate equity.
